topics.topic: Describe a memorable trip you have taken.
prompt_lines: And explain why it was memorable
follow_up: How has this trip influenced you?
Would you recommend this place to others? Why?

topics.topic: Describe a person who has influenced you greatly.
prompt_lines: And explain how they influenced you
follow_up: What qualities do you admire most about this person?
Do you think role models are important for young people?

topics.topic: Describe a book or film you enjoyed recently.
prompt_lines: When you read or watched it
And explain why you would recommend it to others
follow_up: Do you prefer books or films? Why?
How do stories and media influence the way we think?

topics.topic: Describe an important event in your life.
prompt_lines: And explain why it was important to you
follow_up: How has this event changed you as a person?
Do you think people should reflect more on important life events?

topics.topic: Describe a place you like to visit in your free time.
prompt_lines: And explain why you like this place
follow_up: Do you prefer quiet or busy places? Why?
How important is it for cities to have public spaces?

topics.topic: Describe a skill you would like to learn.
prompt_lines: Why you want to learn it
How you plan to learn it
And explain how it would benefit you
follow_up: Do you think it is easier to learn new skills today than in the past?
What skills do you think will be most important in the future?
